messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for AI without making unsupported claims?

### 短答
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for AI without unsupported claims, you need formal R&S product/configuration evidence, competitor official or third-party evidence, AI-use-case evidence that directly ties AI requirements to signaling/non-signaling testing, and measured or documented comparison data; the current battle cards and AI server mapping are sales-positioning or lead-mapping sources, not binding technical proof.[4][7][13][58][76]
### Required evidence
| Evidence needed | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| Formal R&S specifications and features documents for the signaling tester configuration | The CMX500 formal basis is the specifications document and the Features and Functions document; the specs document is binding under stated conditions, while the Features and Functions document says data without tolerance limits is not binding.[12][91] | Use CMX500 specs Version 11.00 and CMX500 Features Version 32 / CSW 9.20.0+ as the traceable basis, not battle-card wording.[12][58] |
| Formal configuration / ordering evidence for the exact signaling solution | The UAV signaling solution note says its CMX500 5G/Wi‑Fi configuration table does not cite a formal configuration guide, software version, license bundle, quote-tool version, or release date, and it should not be treated as a final quote or complete configuration.[19] | The note can provide configuration leads, but formal configuration and ordering proof is still required before comparison or quotation.[19][84] |
| Formal evidence for non-signaling / production-tester capability | Manufacturing / production tools are listed as CMP180, CMP200, CMW100, and CMX500/CMW500 for signaling, but product-specific formal feature lists and ordering evidence are still needed for any production or non-signaling claim.[27][96] | Battle-card claims that R&S scales to CMP180/CMP200/CMW100 production lines are sales positioning and need the relevant product specifications/options as proof.[9][29] |
| Competitor official datasheets, product brochures, configuration guides, option lists, versions, order numbers, and dated documents | Keysight battle-card claims lack official Keysight datasheets or versions; Anritsu MT8000A numeric claims require Anritsu official sources; Amarisoft limitations require Amarisoft official or third-party confirmation.[3][35][41] | R&S internal battle cards alone are not enough for customer-facing competitor claims.[6][8][42] |
| Evidence that directly links the AI use case to signaling / non-signaling testing | The AISeverEcosystem mapping only records Excel-based sales/test-solution leads and does not represent formal product configuration, verified opportunities, customer relationships, or formal test conditions.[13][76] | The provided AI server passages map mostly ZNA/ZNB, FSWP, MXO, ZISO, OSP, and related high-speed/power/clock test leads, but they do not verify that Signaling / Non-signaling Tester is required for the AI server market.[18][78][79] |
| Measured benchmark or test-method evidence for “AI” claims | Generative AI user experience testing is described as a PR/demonstration-level testbed, and the source says mature metrics and standardized test frameworks are still lacking.[49][51] | To compare AI performance claims, you would need methodology, test cases, LLM/terminal/server environment, network profiles, statistical confidence, and result tables, which the current source does not provide.[51] |
| Evidence for any AI automation claim in the tester workflow | The CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant is described as an AI-driven scripting support solution for CMX500, but the source does not provide product model, version, license code, order number, availability date, deployment details, supported models, validation method, accuracy, supported CMX release, or usage limits.[43][46] | Claims such as script-generation accuracy, productivity gain, security model, or commercial availability require additional formal product documentation or validation results.[46][48] |
| Test conditions for any performance or “advantage” claim | Sales-card claims such as “only,” “first,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” or “fully integrated” require formal evidence before use in technical comparisons or customer documents.[1][6][62] | Bandwidth, data rate, FR3/RFU18, TCO, box-count, throughput, and calibration claims need datasheets, option codes, configurations, test conditions, and measured results.[1][61][63] |
| Side-by-side comparison matrix with identical scope and conditions | R&S and competitor claims must be normalized by product SKU, option, software version, hardware configuration, frequency range, bandwidth, carrier count, MIMO layers, modulation, channel model, calibration state, and test setup because the existing sources repeatedly flag missing conditions for both R&S and competitors.[1][3][19][35] | Without matched conditions, the comparison should be limited to “source says” positioning, not technical superiority.[4][7][58] |
### What cannot be claimed yet
A customer-facing claim that our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution is better than a competitor “for AI” is not supported by the current passages, because the AI server mapping is not a formal product/configuration source and does not verify signaling/non-signaling tester fit for that AI market.[13][76][78]
A claim that competitor limitations are factual cannot rely only on R&S battle cards, because the passages state that Anritsu, Amarisoft, and Keysight battle-card material is sales positioning and needs official competitor or third-party evidence for customer documents.[6][8][35][41][58]
A claim that AI tester automation is commercially specified or benchmarked cannot be made from the CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant passages alone, because the source lacks version, license, order number, availability, deployment, model, validation, accuracy, and supported-release details.[46]

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 原文未解的問題
- unresolved：來源是 lossy derivative；原始 PDF 才是 source of truth。
- unresolved：來源標示 COMPANY CONFIDENTIAL；未說明可對外使用範圍。
- unresolved：來源未提供 [[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515B]]、[[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]] 的正式文件編號、版本、order number 或日期。
- unresolved：來源未提供 [[RFU18]] 的正式 order number、datasheet、release date、supported CMX500 configurations、校準條件或 availability。
- unresolved：來源說 [[RFU18]] up to 18 GHz、max aggregated NR bandwidth 2000 MHz，但未提供測試條件、band combination、carrier count、SCS、modulation、MIMO layers 或 binding tolerance。
- unresolved：來源說 R&S first validated 3GPP NR-NTN conformance with [[Samsung]]，但未提供 validation report、test case list、PTCRB RFT 555 版本或日期。
- unresolved：來源多處使用 only、first、leadership、lower TCO、fewer boxes 等 sales language；需要正式證據才能在技術比較或客戶文件中使用。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[Keysight]] 描述為大型美國 test & measurement vendor，總部在 Santa Rosa, California, USA，員工數約 **16,800+**，在 semiconductor、aerospace / defense、cloud 與 wireless testing 具有強市場存在。
- 來源主張 [[Keysight]] mobile communications strategy 越來越 software-led 與 AI-driven，但 [[Keysight UXM]] portfolio 分散於多個 hardware SKUs：[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515B]]、[[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]]。
- 來源列出 [[Keysight]] portfolio 包含 UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms、[[ProbSim]] channel emulators、[[Nemo]] field test tools、[[RaySim]] digital twin engine、[[Atlas]] AI-powered device test、C-V2X 與 cybersecurity tools。
- 來源把 R&S positioning 表述為：[[R&S CMX500]] 在 one instrument 中整合 [[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、[[Wi-Fi]]、[[Fading]]、IP throughput、RF analysis、[[NTN]]、[[RedCap]] 與 end-to-end signaling；而 Keysight 需分散於多個 UXM models、add-on software 與 external tools。

Generative AI user experience testing › 測試目的
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and China Mobile Research Institute jointly demonstrate generative AI user experience testing]]，industry still lacks mature metrics and standardized test frameworks for evaluating user experience of generative AI applications；[[3GPP]] 與 [[GTI]] 等組織正在進行 related research。

本來源中的 testbed 目標是：

- 在 diverse wireless environments 下量化 end-user experience。
- 比較不同 network conditions 對 generative AI application response 的影響。
- 支援 on-device generative AI application design optimization。
- 為 future network optimization 提供 reference points。
- 支援 [[6G-enabled AI technologies]] 的 evolution、validation and standardization。

Generative AI user experience testing
[[Generative AI user experience testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz and China Mobile Research Institute jointly demonstrate generative AI user experience testing]] 中描述的測試方法：在可控制的 wireless network conditions 下，以 [[Time to First Token]]、[[Tokens Per Second]] 等指標量化 generative AI application 的 end-user experience。

Generative AI user experience testing › 使用限制
- 本頁是 PR / demonstration-level evidence，不是正式 test specification、standardized benchmark 或 product datasheet。
- 來源未提供 measurement methodology、test case definition、LLM model、terminal model、server / cloud environment、network scenario profiles、statistical confidence 或 result tables。
- 來源未標示 [[R&S CMX500]] software version、licenses、hardware configuration、extension boards 或 order numbers。
- 來源未說明 host PC software 的產品名稱、版本、license 或資料輸出格式。
- 來源未說明 [[3GPP]] 或 [[GTI]] 是否已採納本 testbed 的 metrics 或 framework。

Virtual tester › 來源定義
[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 的 short definitions 寫道：

> Virtual tester: an agentic workflow that spans implementation → test → debug → validation, not a single tool.

因此本庫把 [[Virtual tester]] 記為工作流 / solution concept，而非單一軟體工具或儀器。

Virtual tester › 與 point tools 的區分
問卷第 3b 題要求客戶說明他們是在尋找 point tools，或 broader [[Virtual tester]]：

- point tools examples：better scripting、log analysis。
- broader [[Virtual tester]]：spans implementation → test → debug → validation。

這個區分表示 [[Virtual tester]] 的範圍比單一 scripting assistant 或 log analyzer 更寬，但來源未提供具體產品功能矩陣。

Virtual tester › 可能涵蓋的流程
依問卷上下文，[[Virtual tester]] 相關需求可能涉及：

- test idea 到 running, [[Validated results]] 的流程理解；
- test script generation 或 refactoring；
- ambiguous logs / failure debugging；
- documentation lookup；
- end-to-end test execution；
- toolchain integration：repos、CI/CD、test frameworks、lab equipment interfaces、log / analysis pipelines；
- [[Orchestration layer]] 對 AI agents 的 rules、instructions、skills coordination。

以上是問卷問題範圍，不是已確認產品功能。

CMX500 GPRF Generator
[[CMX500 GPRF Generator]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中的 [[R&S CMX500]] non-signaling use case：在 CMX500 上產生 ARB、CW、dual tone 或 replay `.wv` waveform，支援 R&D waveform replay / creation 與 standalone TX measurement 工作流。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › 使用限制
- [[CMX500_Callbox]] 是簡報來源，不是 formal feature list 或 specifications。
- `No License required` 只可先記為 GPRF Generator slide claim；technology-specific ARB replay / WinIQSim2 waveform 明確需要 KWxxx licenses。
- Planned for CSW 9.00 / coming with CSW 9.10 需以 release note 驗證。
- 本頁未補推 KW option 的 order number；需回正式 CMX500 features、pricing 或 configurator。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › IQ recorder
來源稱 IQ recorder 可：

- Record up to 4 Gbyte to a file。
- Save files as `.wv` for replay。
- Use the same IQ stream + RF parameters as signaling。
- As many instances as supported by CMX hardware。
- 2 per RFU。
- 1 per IFU。
- FR1 specialist：8 instances in parallel。
- Inspect the recorded trace directly in GUI。

⚠️ [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）說 quick comparison table 中 [[R&S CMX500]] cellular FR1 up to **18 GHz**、FR2 up to **50 GHz (RRH evo)**，但既有頁面 [[R&S CMX500]] 依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 說 [[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF unit frequency range **400 MHz to 8000 MHz**，[[R&S CMX-B500A]] IF generator **6 GHz to 20 GHz**、IF analyzer **4 GHz to 20 GHz**，FR2 remote radio heads 為 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMXHEAD50]] / [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]]。判斷：battle card 可能將 FR1 / FR3 / RFU18 roadmap 口徑混寫；正式規格比較不得直接引用 quick table 的 FR1 up to 18 GHz，需等待 RFU18 或 FR3 正式規格文件。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › Battle card 中的 R&S positioning
來源的 positioning statement 主張：

- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] delivers the industry’s only fully integrated platform for FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi、fading、IP throughput、RF analysis、NTN、RedCap and end-to-end signalling in one instrument。
- 來源說 [[Keysight]] spreads equivalent capabilities across multiple UXM models、add-on software and external tools。
- 來源說 R&S ensures long-term scalability、measurement accuracy and path from R&D to certification without hardware fragmentation。

使用限制：以上是 sales language；其中 only、industry’s only、fully integrated、long-term scalability、lower TCO 等敘述不能當作可驗證規格，需回查正式 datasheet、features document、conformance report 或配置工具。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + Fading + IP**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 unified system，對比 Anritsu 的 MT8000A、MT8862A、IP Option 012 + external PC、external fading chambers 與 separate RF boards。
- **FR2 / FR3 performance leadership**：主張 R&S up to 50 GHz FR2、>16 GHz instantaneous bandwidth、>10 Gbps data rates 與 FR3 via RFU18；使用時需加註非正式規格限制。
- **Integrated WLAN signaling**：主張 R&S Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling directly inside CMX500，Anritsu 需 separate MT8862A。
- **R&D → Conformance → Production**：CMX500、CMW500、CMP180、CMP200、CMW100 構成 one vendor / one workflow / full lifecycle。
- **Future-proof technology**：Validated NTN、ORAN ORU / Conformance with partners、FR3 beyond 16 GHz、RedCap Rel-17/18。
- **Unified software ecosystem**：R&S Test Automation Suite 與 unified user experience；對比 Anritsu SSNR、RTD、ATS、MX844030PC。此項與 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 對 MX844030PC common RTD GUI 的說明並列保留，使用時需標明來源層次。
- **Fewer Boxes. More Capability.**：以 fewer calibrations、fewer licenses、lower TCO、higher test throughput 作為 sales message；來源未提供 TCO 算式。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 與 Anritsu MX844030PC 官方 brochure 的關係
[[mx844030pc-j1200]]（2026-02-10）是 Anritsu 對 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 的 product brochure，確認 MX844030PC 為 **Virtual Signalling Tester NR Software**，支援 MAC-IF、PHY-IF Digital-IQ 與 RF-IF for RedCap，並使用 common [[RTD]] GUI 連接 Pre-silicon / Post-silicon protocol testing workflow。

⚠️ 來源 [[mx844030pc-j1200]]（2026-02-10）說 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 使用 common [[RTD]] GUI，讓 NR protocol test cases 可在 Post-Silicon 與 Pre-silicon phase 間移植，但既有頁面 [[R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu]] 說 Anritsu software 為 SSNR + RTD + ATS + MX844030PC 的 fragmented / disconnected tools。判斷：官方 brochure 支撐 MX844030PC 與 RTD 有整合面；battle card 的 fragmented 判斷仍可作為 R&S sales positioning，但不得當作 Anritsu 官方規格描述。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 是否需要 FR1 bandwidth beyond 400 MHz，例如 600–800 MHz per carrier for 5G-Advanced Rel-18 / Rel-19 testing？
2. 是否需要 FR1、FR2、FR3、WLAN 與 LTE 在 single instrument 中且不用 hardware swaps？
3. 是否需要 native fading with high-throughput IP testing？
4. 是否偏好 one unified software platform，而不是 four separate tools？
5. 是否需要 advanced CA 或 mobility without adding extra boxes？
6. 是否需要 FR3 testing beyond 16 GHz，以支援 emerging 6G FR3 evaluations？

依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 Anritsu 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 提供 single integrated platform，涵蓋 FR1、FR2、FR3、fading、IP throughput、NTN、Wi-Fi、RF analysis 與 signaling；相對地，[[Anritsu MT8000A]] 被描述為需要多 RF boards、external mmWave converters、multiple boxes、external PC / tools 與 fragmented software ecosystem。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 [[amarisoft]] 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 與 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 提供 instrument-grade、validated、calibrated、可延伸至 production 的 5G testing path；[[amarisoft]] 則被描述為 COTS hardware + software-defined stack 的 functional testing solution。

依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + Wi-Fi Signaling + Validated Testing**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 integrated platform。
- **Migration Kit**：script conversion、Python / [[XLAPI]] mapping、on-site bring-up、trade-in program；來源未列交付細節或商務條件。

- **O-RAN Upgrade Path**：R&S + [[VIAVI]] → ORU conformance / NES；來源未展開產品與規格。
- **Production Path (ATE)**：將 CMX validation scale 到 [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] production lines。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio

- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。

### 短答
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for AI without unsupported claims, you need formal R&S product/configuration evidence, competitor official or third-party evidence, AI-use-case evidence that directly ties AI requirements to signaling/non-signaling testing, and measured or documented comparison data; the current battle cards and AI server mapping are sales-positioning or lead-mapping sources, not binding technical proof.[4][7][13][58][76]
### Required evidence
| Evidence needed | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| Formal R&S specifications and features documents for the signaling tester configuration | The CMX500 formal basis is the specifications document and the Features and Functions document; the specs document is binding under stated conditions, while the Features and Functions document says data without tolerance limits is not binding.[12][91] | Use CMX500 specs Version 11.00 and CMX500 Features Version 32 / CSW 9.20.0+ as the traceable basis, not battle-card wording.[12][58] |
| Formal configuration / ordering evidence for the exact signaling solution | The UAV signaling solution note says its CMX500 5G/Wi‑Fi configuration table does not cite a formal configuration guide, software version, license bundle, quote-tool version, or release date, and it should not be treated as a final quote or complete configuration.[19] | The note can provide configuration leads, but formal configuration and ordering proof is still required before comparison or quotation.[19][84] |
| Formal evidence for non-signaling / production-tester capability | Manufacturing / production tools are listed as CMP180, CMP200, CMW100, and CMX500/CMW500 for signaling, but product-specific formal feature lists and ordering evidence are still needed for any production or non-signaling claim.[27][96] | Battle-card claims that R&S scales to CMP180/CMP200/CMW100 production lines are sales positioning and need the relevant product specifications/options as proof.[9][29] |
| Competitor official datasheets, product brochures, configuration guides, option lists, versions, order numbers, and dated documents | Keysight battle-card claims lack official Keysight datasheets or versions; Anritsu MT8000A numeric claims require Anritsu official sources; Amarisoft limitations require Amarisoft official or third-party confirmation.[3][35][41] | R&S internal battle cards alone are not enough for customer-facing competitor claims.[6][8][42] |
| Evidence that directly links the AI use case to signaling / non-signaling testing | The AISeverEcosystem mapping only records Excel-based sales/test-solution leads and does not represent formal product configuration, verified opportunities, customer relationships, or formal test conditions.[13][76] | The provided AI server passages map mostly ZNA/ZNB, FSWP, MXO, ZISO, OSP, and related high-speed/power/clock test leads, but they do not verify that Signaling / Non-signaling Tester is required for the AI server market.[18][78][79] |
| Measured benchmark or test-method evidence for “AI” claims | Generative AI user experience testing is described as a PR/demonstration-level testbed, and the source says mature metrics and standardized test frameworks are still lacking.[49][51] | To compare AI performance claims, you would need methodology, test cases, LLM/terminal/server environment, network profiles, statistical confidence, and result tables, which the current source does not provide.[51] |
| Evidence for any AI automation claim in the tester workflow | The CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant is described as an AI-driven scripting support solution for CMX500, but the source does not provide product model, version, license code, order number, availability date, deployment details, supported models, validation method, accuracy, supported CMX release, or usage limits.[43][46] | Claims such as script-generation accuracy, productivity gain, security model, or commercial availability require additional formal product documentation or validation results.[46][48] |
| Test conditions for any performance or “advantage” claim | Sales-card claims such as “only,” “first,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” or “fully integrated” require formal evidence before use in technical comparisons or customer documents.[1][6][62] | Bandwidth, data rate, FR3/RFU18, TCO, box-count, throughput, and calibration claims need datasheets, option codes, configurations, test conditions, and measured results.[1][61][63] |
| Side-by-side comparison matrix with identical scope and conditions | R&S and competitor claims must be normalized by product SKU, option, software version, hardware configuration, frequency range, bandwidth, carrier count, MIMO layers, modulation, channel model, calibration state, and test setup because the existing sources repeatedly flag missing conditions for both R&S and competitors.[1][3][19][35] | Without matched conditions, the comparison should be limited to “source says” positioning, not technical superiority.[4][7][58] |
### What cannot be claimed yet
A customer-facing claim that our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution is better than a competitor “for AI” is not supported by the current passages, because the AI server mapping is not a formal product/configuration source and does not verify signaling/non-signaling tester fit for that AI market.[13][76][78]
A claim that competitor limitations are factual cannot rely only on R&S battle cards, because the passages state that Anritsu, Amarisoft, and Keysight battle-card material is sales positioning and needs official competitor or third-party evidence for customer documents.[6][8][35][41][58]
A claim that AI tester automation is commercially specified or benchmarked cannot be made from the CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant passages alone, because the source lacks version, license, order number, availability, deployment, model, validation, accuracy, and supported-release details.[46]
